messages:
Diego Morales: hey team, accepted the org invite but trying to open https://github.com/redwood/bootcamp-practice returns 404. Clone also fails with permission denied. Who should I ping?
Nina Lee: welcome Diego! first thing: do you have GitHub 2FA enabled? org requires 2FA and sometimes invites stay limited until that's on.
Diego Morales: i enabled 2FA after the invite. how do i confirm it's recognized by the org?
AccessBot: Hi Diego — to verify, visit https://github.com/orgs/redwood/sso or run `gh auth status`. If SSO/2FA is pending reply `ssocheck` and an admin will review.
Diego Morales: I ran `gh auth status` and it shows me logged in, but the org page still 404s.
Claire Huang: sometimes the issue is email mismatch — if your GitHub account uses an alias email different from the one we invited, team auto-mapping can fail. Diego, what's the account username?
Diego Morales: username is diego-m. I have both diego@personal.com and diego.m@redwood.com on the account. The invite went to diego.m@redwood.com.
Nina Lee: good. confirm that your work email is marked as primary or at least verified on GH. If not, add and verify it. Also re-authorize SSO after that.
Diego Morales: verified work email and re-authorized SSO. Still 404. clone via SSH now returns: "Permission denied (publickey)"
Sam Gupta: run `ssh -T git@github.com` — that'll show which GH account your key is attached to.
Diego Morales: result: "Hi diego-m! You've successfully authenticated..." so SSH is linked.
Claire Huang: ok, i'm checking org console — Diego is a member but not in `bootcamp` team due to a race in the invite flow. Adding you to `engineers/onboarding` with write.
Claire Huang: added. Diego, refresh the repo page.
Diego Morales: can see repo now, thanks! quick follow-up — tried to push to main and got protected branch reject.
Nina Lee: that's expected. bootcamp requires PRs to main with at least one reviewer. Push to a feature branch and open PR.
Diego Morales: done, PR opened. one last Q: my commits show personal email; how do i switch?
Sam Gupta: set `git config user.email "diego.m@redwood.com"`, amend if needed `git commit --amend --reset-author` then push to update the PR.
Diego Morales: fixed, PR updated. thanks everyone! :tada:
